name: Bromo-DragonFLY
toxicity: one can easily overdose if this substance is not measured correctly
summary: A psychedelic phenethylamine and benzofuran that is very potent and has a long duration. Was briefly sold as "2C-B-FLY" in 2005/6 and has led to multiple deaths.
advisory: Efects can last up to many days.

pharmacology.text: Bromo-DragonFLY has very high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, including for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 0.04 nM), serotonin 5-HT2B receptor (Ki = 0.19 nM), and serotonin 5-HT2C receptor (Ki = 0.02 nM). It is a highly potent high-efficacy partial agonist to full agonist of these three receptors. Bromo-DragonFLY is also a potent monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A) inhibitor, which may contribute to its risks.

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2006.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of Bromo-DragonFLY include nausea and vomiting, headache, tachycardia, hypertension, anxiety, panic attacks, pupil dilation, convulsions and vasoconstriction, among others.

fact.en: Its name comes from its shape: the two fused furan rings on either side of the benzene core make the flat molecule look like an insect with wings. It is extremely potent and acts for an unusually long time.
